Missing/unpriced must not become zero; estimated API-equivalent cost is not actual spend or a subscription bill.

neokod_baseline.source_rule: Repository head SHAs are source pins captured on 2026-10-24, not release versions. Source/docs do not prove runtime behavior. The Paseo implementation row is historical-only.
